item.title: Meal Ideas
item.description:
Wraps & Burritos

  • Bolognese Tacos - Mini wraps, Mince, Onion, Grated Carrot, Italian Herbs, Garlic, Sweet Paprika, Tomato Puree
  • Smash Dumpling Tacos - Mince, wraps, soy sauce, sesame seeds, chilli sauce
  • Arayes - mince, garlic, onion, jalapeno
  • Nacho beef folded wrap - Mince, wraps, corn chips, burger sauce, lettuce
  • Cheesy Bacon Jalapeño Popper wrap - mozzarella, cheddar, crumbled bacon, grilled jalapeños, cream cheese, tortilla
  • Garlic honey BBQ pulled chicken tacos
  • Pepper Jack Chicken Burrito - Chicken breast, cheddar, mozzarella, bacon, tortillas, Taco spice, green chilli
  • Beef Bulgogi Burrito (Freezable) - Beef, sushi rice
  • Chicken Bacon Ranch Burrito - Chicken breast, cottage cheese, mozzarella, bacon, tortilla wraps
  • Chicken Parm Baked Wraps
  • Grilled Cheese Burrito
  • Chicken Bacon Ranch Burritos
  • Nacho Cheese Beef Burritos
  • Lasagne Burritos
  • High Protein Grilled Cheese Burritos
  • Spicy Steak & Cheese Burritos
